youtube.title: Are You Actually Behind? What the Typical American Has #Shorts
youtube.description:
Everyone online seems rich. So are you actually behind? Here's what the typical American family really has, using the Federal Reserve's newest data (2025 Survey of Consumer Finances).

• Average (mean) family net worth: about $1.24 million. Averages get dragged up by the very rich.
• Median family net worth: about $215,900
• Median net worth, families under 35: about $33,000
• Median checking + savings: about $8,200

Full breakdown by age on the channel: "You're Not Behind: What the Average American Actually Has".

📌 Educational content only, not financial advice.
